name: The Bands That Changed Music
description: From the Beatles and the Rolling Stones to Nirvana, Daft Punk and BTS: the groups whose sound, studio tricks and style bent popular music in new directions.

checkpoints.name: The sixties explosion
checkpoints.note: The Beatles and the Rolling Stones led a British wave, the Beach Boys and the Supremes brought American sound, and the Velvet Underground, the Who and Led Zeppelin pushed noise and volume.

checkpoints.name: Punk, pop and machines
checkpoints.note: Queen and ABBA made grand pop, Pink Floyd built long albums in the studio, Kraftwerk and Yellow Magic Orchestra built music from machines, and the Ramones, Sex Pistols and Clash tore up the rulebook with short fast songs.

checkpoints.name: Hip hop, grunge and global pop
checkpoints.note: Joy Division and U2 led the post-punk years, N.W.A and Wu-Tang Clan made hip hop a world force, Nirvana and Daft Punk turned guitars and dance floors upside down, and BTS carried K-pop to a global audience.
